PullRequest.Title: Minimap: skip the section header setup when no header is in view
PullRequest.Body:
<!-- Thank you for submitting a Pull Request. Please:
* Read our Pull Request guidelines:
  https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/wiki/How-to-Contribute#pull-requests
* Associate an issue with the Pull Request.
* Ensure that the code is up-to-date with the `main` branch.

-->

`InnerMinimap._renderSectionHeaders` runs on every minimap decorations render. Before looking at the decorations, it always:
- saved the canvas state;
- set up the label style (`letterSpacing`, `font`, which Chromium parses each time, `strokeStyle`, `lineWidth`, `scale`);
- restored the canvas state.

It did this even when the viewport had no section header. This PR gets the decorations first and returns early when there are none.

No issue is associated; this came from profiling.

## Measured on my machine

Code OSS dev build: scrolling, typing and finding in a 47,000-line file with no `#region` or `MARK:` comments.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `_renderSectionHeaders` | 468 ms | 7 ms |
| of which `setStyle` | 445 ms | 0 ms |

## Why the output is unchanged

With no decorations, the old code never reached `frame.add` either, so the recorded frame has the same rows and drawings. The save, style and restore drew nothing. `RowSignatures.diff` compares each row with the previous frame, so rows that showed a header before are still repainted and cleared when the last header leaves the viewport. During review, the recorded frames before and after were compared at pixel ratios 1, 1.67 and 2, including stacked headers, an underline-only header and header removal. All were byte-identical.

## How to test

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `node build/next/index.ts transpile` | passed |
| `./scripts/test.sh --grep "Minimap\|SectionHeaders\|EditorLayoutProvider"` | passed, 47 passing, 0 failing |
| `node_modules/.bin/tsc --project ./src/tsconfig.json --noEmit --skipLibCheck` | passed |
| `pnpm run oxlint src/vs/editor/browser/viewParts/minimap/minimap.ts` | passed |

To try it by hand:
- Section headers (`// #region` and `// MARK:` comments) still show, stack, and disappear when scrolled away.
- Files without headers look the same as before.

RegressionFixes.Mechanism: Repeated synchronous canvas text-style setup once per dirty minimap decorations frame, even when there are zero headers and row-signature comparison subsequently determines that no repaint is needed. Work scales with rendered dirty frames and visible editor instances, independent of header count in the empty case.
RegressionFixes.Symptom: Unnecessary main-thread canvas font/style work consumes the scrolling and typing rendering budget in files with no headers or header-free minimap ranges; the PR reports profiling that attributes most section-header rendering time to setStyle, while the call path independently establishes the repeated wasted work.
RegressionFixes.FixedBehavior: Queries the same viewport decorations first and returns when the filtered header array is empty, avoiding style-string/closure creation, canvas state save/restore and native text style/transform setup on header-free decorations frames. Nonempty-header measurement, sorting, recording and dirty-row replay remain unchanged.
RegressionFixes.Evidence: The diff adds an empty-decoration guard at head lines 2002–2005 before the previously unconditional canvasContext.save()/setStyle(canvasContext) (base 2029–2030). setStyle assigns letterSpacing, font, strokeStyle, lineWidth and a transform. Scroll, selection, decoration and theme handlers mark _renderDecorations; renderDecorations calls _renderSectionHeaders once per dirty decorations render, before RowSignatures.diff can skip an unchanged repaint. Thus even a warm, unchanged, header-free frame previously entered canvas text styling despite never recording a header drawing. View._scheduleRender coalesces pending events, so the removed cost is once per rendered dirty minimap, not per raw input event or file line. Blame resolves base line 2030 to edb01abaf1c7e5802b0e8b1e5dfff8ea2a2ce1e9. The PR's reported profiling is corroborating but not independently reproduced.

Scenarios.Scenario: Scrolling, typing, selection changes or find decorations when the minimap range contains no section headers
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The main-thread editor render synchronously executes minimap layout, decorations recording, row-signature comparison and line rendering before the frame can complete. The new guard skips header styling after the unchanged local decoration query.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Native canvas save, letter-spacing/font/stroke/line-width setters, scale and restore for header measurement preparation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Before: one setup/save/restore per dirty decorations render regardless of zero headers. After: zero on an empty header array.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Performed the setup before querying section-header decorations, even when no header drawing was recorded or replayed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Synchronous native canvas text-style work previously consumed the rendering budget; the guard removes it from this scenario.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Canvas clipping, clearRect and replay of other minimap decorations when RowSignatures.diff finds dirty rows.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One clipped clear/replay pass only when signatures differ; unchanged empty frames need none.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Same row-signature comparison and conditionally clipped repaint. Local model queries reach in-memory buffers and decoration trees, not subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database or network calls.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Remains on the synchronous rendering path without increased work.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of dirty minimap decorations renders across visible editors; each performs one ordinary decoration-range query and one expanded section-header-range query. Range work scales with covered view lines and matching decorations; folding can split local model queries into visible contiguous groups. Header count is zero.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single-threaded synchronous rendering. View._scheduleRender coalesces pending events per editor; EditorRenderingCoordinator groups renders into animation-frame phases. The guard runs once per dirty minimap decorations render, not once per raw input event.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: View-model decoration objects are cached by decoration ID and reset on decoration or line-mapping changes; range-result arrays are rebuilt. Header text uses an existing bounded LRU, but it is not consulted in this scenario. Previously even warm unchanged frames configured canvas text styles before dirty-row comparison; now both cold and warm empty frames skip that work.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: complete diff and event/render call paths show that the same query now precedes a guard that removes unconditional setup, with no added query or retained state.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: No profiling was executed. The actual canvas font-setting duration and frequency of dirty frames vary by browser, document and workflow; author-reported timings were not independently reproduced.
Scenarios.Verdict: No introduced performance regression. The change fixes repeated useless canvas styling; its provenance was recorded separately.

Scenarios.Scenario: Rendering populated minimap section headers, including dense nested headers, underline-only headers and sampled large files
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The same synchronous range query, sort, text fitting, frame recording, row diff and conditional canvas replay must finish before rendering completes. Moving the query/sort before style preparation does not add work.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Canvas style preparation and measureText for fitted labels.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One measurement-style setup per nonempty-header decorations render; two measureText calls per uncached nonempty label. Cache evictions can cause repeated misses, identically before and after.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Queried and sorted the same headers after style setup, then used the same text LRU and fitting function.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Synchronous existing measurement work stays on the rendering path with identical multiplicity.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Canvas style setup, fillRect/fillText and optional separator path stroke for dirty header drawings.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One callback per recorded header intersecting the dirty band; text and separator operations depend on that header's content/style. No replay when all row signatures are unchanged.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Identical label stacking, signatures, drawing callbacks and clipping. Range retrieval remains synchronous in-memory model access with no subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database or network boundary.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Same dirty-row-limited drawing on the rendering critical path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: H filtered headers in the expanded minimap range: unchanged O(H log H) sorting and O(H) recording. Query results can span a larger model range with sampling. Text measurement scales with cache misses among distinct nonempty labels, not automatically with every header.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Sequential JavaScript and canvas calls in each editor's coalesced render. No Promise fan-out, subprocesses or per-header IPC. Recorded header callbacks replay only when their row bands intersect the dirty band.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Existing LRUCache<string,string>(10,1.5) caches fitted header text by label. Hits bypass measureText; misses perform the existing two measurements of label and ellipsis. Underline-only headers have no text measurements. Decoration-ID caching and line-render reuse are unchanged; no new cache keys, lifetime or invalidation behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: only the query/sort placement and empty guard changed; the populated-header path retains all measurement and replay code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The number of visible headers, distinct labels, cache evictions and browser text-rendering cost are workload-dependent; no new scaling mechanism is present.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Existing header scaling and cache behavior are preserved.

Scenarios.Scenario: Last section header leaves the minimap range or is removed
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The empty-header guard returns only from _renderSectionHeaders. Its caller still compares the new frame to previous row signatures and clears/replays dirty rows before completing the render.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Clip and clear rows whose previous signatures included header drawings, then replay remaining intersecting drawings.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One dirty-band clear/replay pass on the transition, just as before. Header-style preparation is now zero rather than one.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Built the same frame without header drawings, but first performed unused style preparation. RowSignatures.diff already handled drawing removal.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required existing repaint remains reachable after the guard; no full-canvas repaint or repeated replay is introduced.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One dirty decorations render for the coalesced transition; row comparison scales with canvas height and replay with other recorded drawings intersecting the dirty band.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous per-editor render under the same animation-frame coalescing; no new asynchronous work or scheduling.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Previous decoration-row signatures remain available for comparison and are replaced by the new frame's rows. The existing bounded text LRU is unchanged; the guard adds no retention and does not suppress signature replacement.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the guard is confined to header recording, whereas dirty-row comparison and replay are outside it. RowSignatures.diff compares previous and next rows, including disappearance.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The cleared band depends on previous headers and other decorations; static analysis establishes identical signatures and unchanged repaint scope, not measured duration.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression: header cleanup does not require skipped setup and repaint cardinality remains unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: Disabled minimap or zero-sized minimap canvas
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Existing RenderMinimap.None or zero-width/height checks return before the changed section-header method. This path performs no changed work.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: At most one existing early-return check per selected minimap render; no header query, fitting or drawing attributable to the changed method.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Existing synchronous early return; editor render scheduling is unchanged.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No changed cache access or allocation is reached.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: render and renderDecorations explicitly guard these cases before calling _renderSectionHeaders.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: No material uncertainty about changed work because the method is unreachable in these cases.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression; the diff is off these paths.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance-review pass over the complete single-file inventory and both diff hunks. Traced events, coalesced editor rendering, local model decoration queries, text LRU, recorded frames and dirty-row replay. No high-confidence diff-introduced performance regressions found. Recorded one concrete repeated-work regression fix with base-line blame provenance. Static read-only review; no runtime measurements.
